items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Closing delivery and suction 
 valves of filters & coolers.

Be sure filters & coolers must be 
 completely venting & drainage for oil to clean tank.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Main Crane, Alfa Laval,

Manual Puller, Feeler Gauge, Rags, 
 Cleaning Fluid,
Dial Indicator, Vibrometer.

Check discharge quantity and 
 pressure and compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out 
 components (if it is needed).
Check leakage of oil & water
Check temperature in & out
Check level.

sections.text:
Filters , cooler & Tank out of 
service

items: Closing delivery and suction valves of filters & coolers.

Be sure filters & coolers must be completely venting & 
 drainage for oil to clean tank.

Clean oil by Alfa Laval and adjust oil level of tank to site 
 values which is (highest from top of tank = 500 mm & lowest from top of tank = 
 550 mm).
Check bolts fixation, then retightens it (if it is needed).
Check the validity of oil and add or change it (if it is needed).

Clean the tank if it is needed & flashing the tank with the oil requirement 
 10 m3.
Check flanges for leakage.
Check Filtration particle size clean or replace (if it is needed).
